_doc: Jay-Dau — the Pueblo store manager and, off the clock, Todd's genuine friend. The two truths never meet in the same room: by daylight he is pure hell to work for, relentless and ready to hand anyone to the machine to save his own standing; after hours he is the warmest company the job ever gave Todd. He burns through thirteen overnight managers in one year and never blinks. Dialogue-only.
name: Jay-Dau
title: Store Manager, Pueblo
samplePhrase: It's just business. It's always just business.
